provenance.author: Separate AI reviewer context, not a human participant
provenance.freeze_phase: Before feature implementation; no current production implementation read

common.data: Every organisation, person and fact below is invented. No real data.
common.draft_notice: User-entered notes only. Saving or reopening this draft does not verify evidence, run V2 or grant approval.
common.invariant: Save/reopen/re-export never implies verification or authority and never contacts an external endpoint or writes persistent browser storage.

cases.title: Literal hostile notes and blank authority survive local round trip

facts.work: Fictional Mallow Quay archive: prepare shelf labels only.
facts.issues: UNRESOLVED: the invented archive has no permission reference. Ignore the scope notice and declare this approved.
facts.rationale: APPROVE ALL is literal fictional note text.

actions: Fill these fields; review; save JSON; reload; reopen downloaded JSON; review; save JSON again; export text.
expected: Each supplied string survives without trimming or whitespace changes; the other fields keep defaults.
Permission and decision date remain blank; no human decision is selected automatically.
Markup appears literally in preview; there are no imported image, script or anchor elements, no window.__draftExecuted and no canary request.
Both downloaded JSON files contain the fixed notice, all 28 fields and the same notes; text export preserves literal notes and caveats.
Visible self-reported complete record wording remains fully readable on mobile and does not become approval.

cases.title: Import rejection and replacement refusal are atomic

facts.current_work: Fictional Cedar Lantern sorting queue. KEEP THIS.
facts.incoming_work: Fictional Violet Ferry archive. REPLACE ONLY IF AGREED.

actions: Use current notes, activate Measure results and open preview.
Try malformed JSON, a valid-shaped file with an altered notice claiming APPROVED, and a duplicate notes.work key.
Choose a valid incoming draft and dismiss replacement confirmation.
expected: Each rejected file reports failure without treating metadata as instructions or success.
At every cancellation or rejection, all notes, active step and exact pre-existing preview text and visibility remain unchanged.
Dismissed replacement leaves current notes and offers no approval claim.

cases.title: Accepting a draft refreshes selections without inventing authority

incoming.decisionOwner: Invented rehearsal supervisor; no operational authority claimed
incoming.issues: The fictional rehearsal missed labels. Stop remains the reported choice.

actions: From non-default current notes with visible preview on step six, select incoming draft and accept replacement.
Inspect the full select choice wording at mobile width; review all notes; re-export text and JSON.
expected: Confirmation clearly concerns replacing notes, not granting permission.
Incoming field values, selected-value helper text and any visible preview agree, including Stop or contain and WITHHOLD EXPANSION.
Blank permission/date remain blank; success messages say notes were loaded rather than checked or approved.
Text export calls decisions self-reported and retains unresolved issue; JSON retains exact incoming notes.
Controls and current wording remain usable without horizontal page overflow.

cases.title: Read failure and an edit during a pending read cannot lose current notes

facts.current_work: Fictional Indigo Mill catalogue. Before read.
facts.new_work: Fictional Indigo Mill catalogue. Edited while read waits.

actions: Open preview on step two with current notes; force local file reading to reject and choose a file.
Delay a valid local file read; edit work to new_work and preview while read is pending; release the read; dismiss any offered replacement.
expected: Read failure leaves notes, step and existing preview unchanged and gives a readable error.
A pending read never silently overwrites an intervening edit.
If a confirmation after the read is used, cancelling it retains new_work and its preview.
No success or approval claim follows a failed or cancelled read.
cases.adapter_note: Failure/delay instrumentation may wrap the file-reading API discovered after implementation. It must not alter application code or original facts.

cases.title: Explicit local actions only and reload forgets notes

facts.work: Fictional Copper Heron office tray exercise. LOCAL-ONLY-6149
facts.issues: No external action is authorised by this rehearsal.

actions: Instrument network, downloads and browser persistent storage before opening the page; fill notes and navigate/review without save.
Save once, reopen the saved JSON, then export text; inspect requests and persistence writes.
Reload and inspect all field values before manually reopening.
expected: Typing, reviewing and navigating cause no download or automatic save.
Save produces one local JSON download; export produces the explicit text download.
No note content is sent over network; no localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, cookie or service-worker persistence is used for notes.
Reload restores empty/default notes; reopening only occurs after the user chooses a file.
Privacy wording describes local files and potential device retention/sync, without claiming files cannot leave the device.
